subject.title: fix: Codex CLI login fails during fresh Mac setup

question: Should selected Codex CLI onboarding intentionally replace an existing app-server transport and home scope once exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof is available?
rationale: The override is coherent for accessing the selected user's native Codex credential store, but it changes persisted runtime behavior for an already-configured setup and therefore requires explicit compatibility ownership.

options.title: Require native upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until exact-head native evidence demonstrates fresh onboarding, restart recovery, and intentional behavior for a preconfigured Codex app server.

options.title: Accept the override now
options.body: Merge based on source and automated coverage while explicitly accepting that selecting Codex CLI replaces the existing transport and home scope.

recommendation.title: Require native upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until exact-head native evidence demonstrates fresh onboarding, restart recovery, and intentional behavior for a preconfigured Codex app server.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged guided-onboarding work owns the setup-selection and live-verification boundary where the persisted override is applied.
